{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("QA order count after cleaning:", qa_count)"}
